contour_admission: Discard individually short/noncircular contours before combining centers; require three passing contours. No threshold relaxation from v1.
split: Hold out grid cells with (iu//2 + iv//2) % 4 == 0; no target-dependent selection
scalar: Mean raw RGB codes for compiled rows; explicit relative linear or encoded proxy for authored controls
scope: Feature hypotheses only; no ray/occupancy certificates, source type/orientation or calibrated photometry
